title: RepositoryRecord
description: A repository the platform is allowed to work in (ADR-0014). The record is the capability ceiling for that repository. ADR-0014 §5 fixes the precedence: platform policy, then trust-level ceiling, then this record, then the graph node definition — each layer may only narrow. Files resident in the target repository affect context only and have zero capability effect, which is what stops a repository the platform is editing from rewriting the configuration that governs editing it.

networkAllowlist.description: Package registry hosts reachable from this repository's workspaces. Everything else is denied.

approvalOverrides.description: Side-effect classes that always require approval in this repository, regardless of the tool's own policy. Narrowing only: this can add an approval requirement, never remove one.

excludePaths.description: Never index secrets or vendored trees. An exclusion here is a retrieval control, not a security boundary; secrets should not be in the repository in the first place.

instructionFiles.description: Repository files surfaced to agents as context. Context only — these carry no capability effect.

requiredChecks.description: Command profiles that must pass before any EXTERNAL_WRITE for this repository. This is how 'the tests must pass before opening a pull request' becomes a platform property rather than an instruction to a model.

configHash.description: Hash of the canonical record. Recorded on every grant and audit entry so that 'what were the rules at the time?' is answerable after the record changes.
